findings: clip2_name empty-list risk — clip1_name has a fallback to get_filename_list("clip") when text_encoders is empty, but clip2_name does not. On installations where CLIP models live under models/clip/, the clip2_name dropdown will be empty and the node will error at runtime. Add the same `or get_filename_list("clip")` fallback.

Full-or-nothing generation — Any exception inside _generate_one re-raises immediately, discarding all partially collected image tensors. A multi-scene batch that fails mid-way produces no output at all. Consider catching per-scene failures with a placeholder tensor, or document the all-or-nothing contract explicitly.

_MODEL_CACHE race condition — The module-level dict has no lock. Two concurrent queue entries with the same model key will both pass the cache check before either finishes loading and will each load the full Flux model set into VRAM. Protect with threading.Lock if concurrency is ever enabled.
